name: The Ritz-Carlton, St. Louis
insider_take: This isn't just luxury—it's St. Louis royalty. The Ritz-Carlton sits majestically in Clayton, where Midwestern charm meets world-class sophistication.
whats_special: The hotel occupies a prime spot in Clayton's bustling business district, just minutes from Forest Park—one of America's largest urban parks, bigger than Central Park! The property features contemporary elegance with local touches, including artwork celebrating St. Louis's jazz heritage and Mississippi River legacy.
pro_tip: Book a west-facing room for stunning sunset views over the Missouri landscape, and time your visit during baseball season—Busch Stadium is just 15 minutes away for Cardinals games.
dont_miss: The hotel's proximity to the iconic Gateway Arch (America's tallest man-made monument), the world-renowned Saint Louis Zoo in Forest Park, and Clayton's upscale shopping at Plaza Frontenac. The nearby Delmar Loop, named one of America's "10 Great Streets," offers eclectic dining and nightlife just a short drive away.
pros: Iconic downtown location with Gateway Arch views
Legendary Ritz-Carlton service and luxury amenities
Prime access to St. Louis attractions and business district
cons: Urban setting with limited outdoor space
